content.short: Antfarm Finance is a DAO-powered DEX focused on liquidity providers, aiming to boost LP profits and reward stakeholders.
content.description: Antfarm Finance is a DAO-powered decentralized exchange built for liquidity providers. Its objective is to let LPs earn more from their liquidity on Antfarm than on other DEXs while simultaneously rewarding all stakeholders, including investors. By linking swapping fees to LP rewards, Antfarm aims to deepen liquidity and reduce slippage, thereby attracting more users and delivering greater profitability and security to liquidity providers.
